IN.sms_spam_reporting: Report on Chakshu portal (sancharsaathi.gov.in/sfc) or forward to 1909
IN.notice: Verify helpline numbers and portal URLs before filing.

upi.why: Reporting within the golden hour enables law enforcement and banks to freeze fraudulent transfers across beneficiary accounts.

upi.action: Contact your bank to report unauthorized UPI debit and block UPI ID
upi.why: Prevents recurring collect debits or compromised credentials from being reused.

upi.action: Report the transaction inside your UPI app (GPay / PhonePe / Paytm)
upi.why: Flags the fraudster's UPI ID / VPA across the NPCI payment network.

card.action: Immediately block your debit/credit card via bank mobile app or phone
card.why: Prevents any further fraudulent transactions on the compromised card.

card.action: File a dispute/chargeback claim with your card issuer
card.why: Initiates card scheme dispute process for unauthorized transactions.

card.action: Report incident to National Cybercrime Helpline 1930
card.why: Registers formal police cybercrime complaint acknowledged by banks.

bank_transfer.why: Enables inter-bank lien marking to stop funds from being withdrawn at destination bank.

bank_transfer.action: Contact your bank's branch manager to initiate IMPS/NEFT/RTGS recall
bank_transfer.why: Formal request from remitter bank to beneficiary bank to reverse or freeze funds.

crypto.action: Save transaction hash (txid), destination wallet address, and chat records
crypto.why: Immutable blockchain records are essential evidence for cyber cell tracking.
Cyber cell coordinates with domestic crypto exchanges to blacklist fraudulent addresses.

gift_card.action: Contact gift card merchant support immediately with card numbers and receipt
gift_card.why: If the scammer has not yet redeemed the voucher code, the issuer can freeze the remaining balance.
Creates an official record of organized gift card extortion.

none.action: Block the sender number and do not respond further
none.why: Responding signals an active number to scammers, leading to coordinated follow-up attempts.

none.action: Report suspected spam number on Chakshu portal (sancharsaathi.gov.in)
none.why: Assists Department of Telecommunications in revoking fraudulent mobile connections.

US.notice: Verify helpline numbers and portal URLs before filing.

upi.action: Contact your peer-to-peer payment provider (Zelle/Venmo/CashApp) immediately
upi.why: Report unauthorized account access or fraudulent transfer request.

upi.action: File report with FTC at reportfraud.ftc.gov
upi.why: Contributes to federal investigations and fraud trend enforcement.

card.action: Call your card issuer's fraud department to cancel card and dispute charges
card.why: Under Regulation E and FCBA, prompt reporting limits consumer liability for unauthorized charges.

card.action: File complaint with FTC at reportfraud.ftc.gov
card.why: Provides legal documentation of identity/payment compromise.

bank_transfer.action: Contact your bank immediately to request a wire recall or freeze
bank_transfer.why: Wire transfers must be recalled before settlement completes at intermediary banks.

bank_transfer.action: File an IC3 complaint with the FBI at ic3.gov
bank_transfer.why: FBI's Recovery Asset Team (RAT) can assist in freezing international and large wire transfers.

crypto.action: File complaint with FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center at ic3.gov
crypto.why: IC3 coordinates with specialized federal cryptocurrency tracing teams.

gift_card.action: Contact the company that issued the gift card right away
gift_card.why: Retailers may freeze cards or refund unredeemed balances.

gift_card.action: Report the gift card scam to reportfraud.ftc.gov
gift_card.why: Helps law enforcement track criminal laundering syndicates.

none.action: Block the sender and report spam SMS to 7726
none.why: Alerts carriers to block the scammer's originating VoIP number.

UK.portal_name: Report Fraud (City of London Police; replaced Action Fraud on 4 Dec 2025)
UK.notice: Verify helpline numbers and portal URLs before filing.

upi.action: Contact your UK bank immediately under Contingent Reimbursement Model (CRM)
upi.why: Authorized Push Payment (APP) scam protections may entitle victims to reimbursement.
Generates a police crime reference number needed for bank reimbursement.

card.action: Contact card provider to freeze card and request chargeback or Section 75 claim
card.why: Statutory consumer protections cover credit card transactions over £100.

bank_transfer.action: Call your bank immediately and inform them of fraudulent transfer
bank_transfer.why: UK banks participate in the CRM code to attempt immediate fund recall.

bank_transfer.action: Report to Report Fraud online or call 0300 123 2040
bank_transfer.why: Police national database logs scam beneficiary sort codes.

crypto.action: Report to Report Fraud and the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA)
crypto.why: FCA maintains a warning list of unauthorized crypto investment firms.

gift_card.action: Notify the gift card merchant support team immediately
gift_card.why: Merchant can investigate and void compromised voucher balances.
Crime reference number required for documentation.

none.action: Block number and forward suspicious SMS to 7726
none.why: Free national service for UK mobile networks to identify spam.
National Cyber Security Centre (NCSC) removes malicious host servers.
